lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular pixel clusters are distributed across the mid-lateral flank in a non-linear grid-like formation, with primary nodes visible posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with horizontal spot rows, creating a low-contrast grid pattern along the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a light upper edge and a shadowed lower margin running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple elongated dark-toned masses, consistent with ectoparasitic remoras, are attached to the dorsal-lateral surface and near the pectoral fin base. A distinct high-luminance white mark is visible at the distal tip of the pectoral fin trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A high density of smaller, lower-intensity speckling is visible in the anterior region of the upper flank, transitioning to larger, more defined blobs towards the mid-section.
